verdict.rationale: Exit waterfall modeling is a fair question for a cap table platform like Carta, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only cap table, stakeholder and share-class retrieval endpoints, plus percentage formulas. None of it shows exit waterfall analysis, proceeds per class or stakeholder across exit values, or handling of liquidation preferences and participation. Those data endpoints are building blocks for constructing a waterfall, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run exit waterfall analyses showing proceeds per share class and stakeholder under different exit values, honoring preferences and participation
